svg.aria-label: Hi! I'm Arjun. I'm a passionate developer with a keen interest in open-source projects and community building. Using Swift to develop Resolve. Taking courses in software engineering, algorithms, testing, and user interfaces. Looking to collaborate on open-source projects in software development and AI. Fun fact: I love photography! Take a look at some of my photos ;). Now: Exchange semester at the Technical University of Munich; Software Engineer at Ivo AI in San Francisco. Tools: Swift, SwiftUI, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Python, Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Figma, JavaScript, Java, C++, GitHub.
